description: The ASP.NET Core relays for bit Bcrdt: the SignalR hub the Bit.Bcrdt.SignalR transport talks to, and the WebSocket endpoint the built-in WebSocket transport talks to. Both only relay - neither decodes a message nor holds a replica.

Test support for bit Bcrdt: a deterministic, seeded network simulator with loss, duplication, reordering, partitions and offline peers; random operation generators; a convergence harness; and an update corrupter for fuzzing the wire format. Framework-neutral, so it works with MSTest, xUnit or NUnit.
Blazor Server (interactive server / circuits) instrumentation for bit BevTools: circuit lifecycle, connection state, inbound activity and an active circuit overview.

FluentValidation integration for Bit.Borm. UseFluentValidation() runs a model's FluentValidation validator alongside the schema's own rules and puts every failure on the field its property path names.
SkiaSharp 기반 .NET UI 라이브러리 (산업용 HMI 터치 패널·일반 앱). XML 마크업 + CSS 식 인라인 style + C# 뷰모델 바인딩. 창에 띄우려면 어댑터 Devinno.UI.OpenTK 또는 Devinno.UI.WinForms 를 함께 씁니다.
Devinno.UI 의 OpenTK 창 어댑터 — ViewWindow 로 DvApp 을 창에 띄웁니다(터치 우선, 가상 키보드, CPU·OpenGL 그리기).
Devinno.UI 의 WinForms 어댑터 — ViewControl 로 DvApp 을 폼에 올립니다(한글 IME 입력, 터치 모드 선택).
